notes.title: Now you can ride Bikes!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We've done many things you might like. Let's start with some code stuff;

    Trader logic improved/some bugs fixed.
    Bike added (WIP)
    Motion blur option fixed
    
**We're gonna add some other things that you guys will like!

On the UI side;

    Main Menu updated
    Tooltips & Tutorial Cards (WIP)


Animations;

    New biking anims
    Animations are more compatible now


Models;

    Zombie reworked
    Added street pack
    Bike


Landscape;

    New landscape
    Updated start area

*Landscape will be updated again

Stay tuned for much more!

notes.title: Now you can check your speed in vehicle with tachometer!
notes.notes:
Let's check things we've added;

- Added a tachometer so you will know what speed you're going at
- Added some sounds to item slots (like backpack, holster etc.)
- Fixed disappearing slot items (They were not spawning when you load game)

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Better lighting performance and new falling sounds!!
notes.notes: Hi everyone, we've made some nice updates!! Now you can get better FPS in game, and test fall damage with sounds ;)

notes.title: Fixed alt camera control
notes.notes: Alt camera control fixed, now you can look around while moving!

notes.title: More loot and new camera control!
notes.notes:
You can look around your character with holding Left ALT now!

Don't forget to check out the new loot! 👀

Stay tuned for new updates!

notes.title: Loots are fixed now!
notes.notes:
You can find loot in 4 houses, it will spawn randomly for each room!

Stay tuned for more updates!
